question: What victory over Rāvaṇa and his lineage is attributed to the goddess by these names?
premises: The goddess is named destroyer of the lineage of the lord of Laṅkā.
She is called the destroyer of great Rāvaṇa.
inference: These epithets credit the goddess with the destruction of Rāvaṇa and his family.
plain_english: She is the destroyer of the lineage of the lord of Laṅkā and the destroyer of great Rāvaṇa.
